query: insert into otp_send_limits (key,window_start,count,expires_at) values ($1,now(),1,now()+interval '1 minute') on conflict (key) do update set count=case when otp_send_limits.expires_at<=now() then 1 else otp_send_limits.count+1 end, expires_at=case when otp_send_limits.expires_at<=now() then now()+interval '1 minute' else otp_send_limits.expires_at end returning count
